assay: bulk RNA-seq (STAR + HTSeq-count), liver, perigonadal WAT, quadriceps muscle
primary_estimand: Effect of 20 weeks of voluntary running-wheel exercise in obese Ldlr-/-.Leiden mice with pre-existing NASH that stay on HFD (HFD+running wheel vs HFD control), per organ (liver, eWAT, muscle)
sample_inclusion: all 50-week animals in the GEO series; organs analysed separately
planned_contrasts: H.Hrw vs H.H (exercise vs HFD control), per organ (abstract METHODS/RESULTS: treatment groups compared with untreated control group; paper DEG count not available)
H.Crw vs H.H (combination vs HFD control), per organ (abstract; count not available)
H.C vs H.H (diet change vs HFD control), per organ (abstract; count not available)
repeated_measure_unit: mouse (mousenr) appears in several organs, but organs are analysed separately, so each fit has one sample per mouse
paper_method: DESeq2 per GEO data_processing ('These counts serve as input for the statistical analysis using DEseq2 package'); exact model and threshold not available (abstract only)
paper_results: Abstract: pathway analysis shows exercise and diet change affect complementary metabolic/lipid-handling pathways and share inflammation pathways; no DEG counts or genes given
